method.sources: Temporary copy of the 151-cell tutorial metrics/session; generated 16-channel, 2000 Hz, six-second binary fixtures for NeuroScope2.
method.isolation: Copied application entry points; disabled database, analytics and preference persistence; suppressed notification dialogs; all save destinations temporary.
method.timingLimitations: Capture-oriented single observations, not comparative benchmarks. Java code-cache warning and rendering fallback were observed. Do not infer speedups or representative startup times.
method.reviewScope: Code inspection, current screenshot inspection, targeted defect reproduction. No production UI code changed and no full regression suite rerun for this review.
